Consider a matrix equation A−1x=Bd, where A and B are 7×7 non-singular matrices, while x and d are 7×1 column vectors. Solve the equation for x.

x=BdA
b
x=BdA−1
c
x=ABd
d
x=A−1Bd
e
x=BAd
